# awscc_accountaccess_application (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::AccountAccess::Application specifying an application for account access



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity_source` (Attributes) The identity source for the application (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identity_source))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `application_arn` (String) The ARN of the application
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the application was created
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the application
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID of the application
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the application was last updated

### Nested Schema for `tags`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_accountaccess_application.example
  identity = {
    application_arn = "application_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Optional

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform

  to = awscc_accountaccess_application.example
  id = "application_arn"

```
